message: Dependabot proposes npm updates after 3 days (default-days: 3 in .github/dependabot.yml), but pnpm waits 1 week (minimumReleaseAge: 10080 in pnpm-workspace.yaml); its pull requests bring in versions younger than pnpm accepts, or fail where the lockfile is re-checked
fix: Make the Dependabot delay at least 1 week, or run depgate apply
